examples.title: Letter Rotations
examples.problem: Rotate the letter 'N' by a half-turn. What do you see?
examples.explanation: Letter N has rotational symmetry of 180 degrees.

examples.title: Fibonacci-like Pattern
examples.solution: 13. The rule is to add the previous two numbers.

examples.title: Mirror Image
examples.problem: Draw the mirror image of the word 'TOY'.
examples.solution: The letters will appear reversed as 'YOT' (with individual letters also flipped).
examples.explanation: Mirror reflection flips the image horizontally.
